name: bizplug-financial-services
description: The financial services & banking plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a banker or advisor meeting. It works from the business's own published profile, covering products, branches and how to get started, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Information and scheduling only: never give financial, investment, tax or legal advice, and never ask for account numbers or ID numbers. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
